notes: Phase 1.3 faction-lifecycle batch. Adds 12 scheduled relationship/disposition events, 12 one-time progressive faction-news events, and 6 rare lore-fallback bulletins. Faction lifecycle is an FSM backed by flags; roles remain orthogonal flags. Most contacts can opt out or close without a faction ending. No passive FIX drift and no global threshold sweep.

text.en: You answer the Department's follow-up with enough documentation to make the case officer close the file. The confirmation letter is longer than the case.
The Department decides your record requires continuing supervision. You become an active Material Status case, although nobody agrees on whether that counts as assistance.
The Department keeps your case open for a second review cycle. Nothing irreversible happens, but the file now has its own reference number.

events.designerNotes: Strong legal/intellectual runs close safely; others enter a real case instead of jumping to an ending.

text.en: You decline Meridian's follow-up package and let the voucher expire. The sales representative calls this 'voluntary loss of future value.'
Meridian's campaign team decides your current appearance meets a short-lived premium criterion. A preservation procedure becomes permanent before the campaign does.
Meridian's campaign team finalizes your existing material trajectory while your promotional eligibility is still current.
You accept a nonpermanent Meridian consultation. The company opens a client file and schedules another eligibility review several years out.

events.designerNotes: Most contacts become a client relationship or safe opt-out. Only extreme CHR+FIX preserves a sudden young-adult ending.

text.en: The Institute decides you are a poor fit for longitudinal work, and you are equally happy to stop being measured. Your subject file closes.
A repeat calibration fails to release you from one experimental second. The Institute logs the result as stable temporal preservation and suspends the protocol.
A repeat calibration pushes your existing material trajectory past the study's stopping criterion. The Institute gets a publishable result and you get a final one.
The Institute invites you back as both a paid subject and a junior research affiliate. The distinction matters mostly for whose name appears on the forms.
You remain in the Institute's longitudinal subject pool. The next study is scheduled far enough away to feel hypothetical.

events.designerNotes: CRI can safely end, become a subject relationship, or rarely produce a sudden experimental ending.

text.en: You read the renewal terms closely enough to cancel before the policy acquires interesting clauses. Everlasting marks the account 'lost to informed behavior.'
You keep the starter policy because the alternatives are worse. Everlasting now treats you as both a client and a future-credit risk.
The starter policy renews on ordinary terms. You remain a client, which is less dramatic than the brochure had promised.

events.designerNotes: Insurance contact becomes a longer relationship or clean cancellation; it no longer schedules a climax immediately.

text.en: You unwind the Black Ledger arrangement before the paperwork becomes enforceable. The intermediary stops returning messages, which is the closest thing they offer to a receipt.
The Black Ledger discovers that the collateral is no longer hypothetical. Enforcement arrives before your next ordinary bill and your existing material condition is realized as the asset.
The arrangement survives its first review and becomes harder to describe as a favor. You are now both a debtor and a person the Cooperative actively tracks.
The Cooperative keeps the account open. You remain a debtor, although for now the debt is more theoretical than your anxiety about it.

events.designerNotes: Underground contact can be exited safely, remain a debt relationship, or rarely become immediate enforcement.

text.en: You decline the Order's next workshop and stop answering the increasingly poetic invitations. Nobody follows up.
A supposedly reversible stillness rite does not reverse. The Order calls the stone form sacred before the civil authorities decide what to call it.
A supposedly reversible stillness rite finalizes your existing material state. The Order calls the result sacred before the civil authorities decide what to call it.
The Order assigns you a mentor with unusual interest in your future form. You are not a member, but the attention becomes difficult to ignore.
You keep attending occasional ceremonies without formally joining. The Order records you as an affiliate and continues sending invitations.

events.designerNotes: Cult contact supports safe exit, affiliation/targeting, and a rare sudden ritual outcome.

text.en: The second review finally closes your Material Status case without further conditions. Several departments retain copies for reasons outside your control.
The Department decides continued supervision is unnecessary. Your case closes as 'provisionally ordinary,' a category that sounds more temporary than it is.
The Department converts your open case into a binding structural-compliance order. Routine appeal is no longer available; the next review concerns how the order will be carried out.

events.designerNotes: DMMS escalation either closes the case or creates a true committed route.

text.en: You decline Meridian's second eligibility review before any permanent service begins. The client file closes and the company stops calling.
Meridian decides the projected maintenance revenue no longer justifies keeping your case open. For once, being unprofitable is protective.
Meridian upgrades your consultation into a binding preservation program. The remaining paperwork is about implementation, not whether the program happens.
Meridian's campaign moves on before your case does. The company closes the file without permanent treatment and sends you a satisfaction survey.

events.designerNotes: Only a subset of Meridian clients become committed preservation cases.

text.en: The Institute removes you from further exposure studies on safety grounds. Your subject relationship closes with a surprisingly sincere apology.
The longitudinal study finishes cleanly. You receive an acknowledgment in the paper and leave the subject pool without becoming the result.
The Institute moves you into a protocol whose stopping condition is now defined in terms of permanent continuity. Withdrawal is no longer treated as an ordinary study procedure.
The Institute completes the study without escalating exposure. You leave with a modest payment, several test results and no active research relationship.

events.designerNotes: CRI escalation has several nonterminal exits; only material/FIX pressure commits it.

text.en: You terminate the policy before its preservation clauses become useful to anyone. Everlasting sends a retention offer after the cancellation is final.
Everlasting restructures your policy into a binding settlement plan secured against future Permanent Form rights. The next qualifying event will be treated as performance, not a new decision.
The policy reaches an uneventful renewal point and you let it lapse. Everlasting records the relationship as successfully concluded because nothing expensive happened.

events.designerNotes: Everlasting commits only financially stressed qualifying cases.

text.en: You force a settlement that extinguishes the Black Ledger claim before it attaches to your body. Nobody congratulates you, which is how you know the exit is real.
The Cooperative converts your account into enforceable future-form collateral. At this point repayment terms and bodily terms have become the same document.
The arrangement collapses under its own accounting and the Cooperative closes your position rather than litigate it. You lose money but keep the more important asset.

events.designerNotes: Black Ledger has a real safe exit, mundane bad outcome, and committed enforcement path.

text.en: You stop attending before the Order asks for a permanent vow. The messages taper off, and the last invitation eventually becomes ordinary recycling.
The Order accepts you into a permanent-vow track whose final rite is no longer described as symbolic. Leaving would now break obligations the group treats as binding.
The Order elevates you from affiliate to public exemplar. The ceremonial program now ends in an explicitly permanent rite.
The Order's interest moves elsewhere before you take a permanent vow. Your affiliation ends without ceremony, which is probably the healthiest possible ceremony.

events.designerNotes: Most affiliates leave/close; commitment needs vulnerability/material pressure or public-symbol conditions.

text.en: The Department of Mobility and Material Status announces a simplified classification form. The new form has three more pages and one fewer appeal box.

events.designerNotes: One-time world-lore news. Does not create personal faction state.

text.en: A high court rules that the Department's simplified classification form was never legally simple. DMMS issues a replacement while the judgment is still being summarized.

events.designerNotes: One-time world-lore news. Does not create personal faction state.

text.en: Everlasting Mutual publishes a new actuarial table assigning projected values to future Permanent Forms. Several economists object to the decimal places.

text.en: Everlasting Mutual settles a long-running dispute over whether post-immobility maintenance counts as healthcare or asset servicing. Both sides claim the wording favors them.

text.en: Meridian Preservation Group launches a 'Forever Twenty-Four' campaign. Regulators object mainly to the asterisk after 'forever.'

events.designerNotes: One-time world-lore news. Does not create personal faction state.

text.en: Meridian recalls a generation of preservation pedestals after discovering that a decorative finish interferes with standard maintenance scans. The bodies are unaffected, according to Meridian.

text.en: The Continuity Research Institute publishes a study arguing that legal identity survives more transformation categories than existing forms acknowledge. Three ministries request different corrections.

text.en: The Continuity Research Institute suspends one laboratory after an ethics review finds that 'temporary' had been defined by the researchers rather than by clocks.

events.designerNotes: One-time world-lore news. Does not create personal faction state.

text.en: Authorities seize a portfolio of future-form rights linked to the Black Ledger Cooperative. Nobody can agree whether the seized assets currently exist.

text.en: A new consultancy begins offering suspiciously familiar future-form financing services. It denies any connection to the Black Ledger while using the same office furniture.

text.en: The Order of the Last Posture gains attention after several universities recognize its stillness society as a legitimate student organization. The insurance office is less enthusiastic.

events.designerNotes: One-time world-lore news. Does not create personal faction state.

text.en: A sacred-property case involving the Order reaches national court. The central question is whether a consecrated Permanent Citizen can also be venue infrastructure.

text.en: The Department issues another Material Status circular clarifying a rule that most people only learn exists when the clarification arrives.

events.designerNotes: Late-life lore fallback. Rarely repeatable, mechanically inert, and reported separately from generic fallback.

text.en: Everlasting Mutual updates another line of its actuarial guidance. The financial press spends a day debating whether the change is reassuring.

text.en: Meridian launches another preservation service with a new name, a familiar maintenance contract, and a waiting list.

text.en: The Continuity Research Institute publishes another result that slightly changes how professionals describe a Permanent Form and not at all how ordinary people do.

text.en: Another future-form financing scandal is rumored to involve the Black Ledger. The organization, if it still exists, does not comment.

text.en: The Order of the Last Posture appears in the news again over a ceremony, a property dispute, or both. The details differ more than the photographs.
